Label: Onboard First
Rationale: Easy-to-medium collection with critical importance. Backbone of IT-to-OT crossing identity and remote-access-abuse detection - the two most common OT compromise paths.

Label: Onboard Next
Rationale: High or critical importance but harder to instrument (PLC, Safety Controller) or lower urgency/volume (Historian, Router, Backup). Safety Controller events always page out.

Label: Fill Coverage Gaps
Rationale: High value but high engineering effort. LS-18 here means expansion beyond the priority-1 boundary sensor pilot to cell/area coverage; it requires SPAN/TAP architecture, asset context, protocol parsing, and DPI tuning.

Label: Do Not Collect Directly
Rationale: State already represented indirectly via PLC/RTU telemetry and historian; native collection adds cost for near-zero marginal detection value.
